Project Overview

Maintain and develop the Jentezen Franklin Media Ministries website using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Ruby in collaboration with two developers. Create interface designs in Figma before implementation, conduct routine site audits, and coordinate site direction and technical updates with project stakeholders.

Led the October 2023 website redesign and rebrand, refining the visitor experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Introduced rounded corners and transitioned the site typography to San Francisco Pro.

This project is currently in development.

Explore the pre-redesign site on the Wayback Machine.
